{{Quote|We'll need&hellip;one smallish hydraulic metal press, not traceable to us, transportable in our speeder.|Voort saBinring|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
A '''hydraulic press''' was a machine capable of crushing objects with immense force.<ref name="MK" />

In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] used a hydraulic press to reach the outer hull of his [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], when he was forced to remove a [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]] detonator from the ship.<ref name="MR">''{{InsiderCite|131|Maze Run|reprint=1}}]''</ref>

In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> the newly formed [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]] used an aging hydraulic press to destroy the [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|army]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandor-3]] during a mission.<ref name="MK" />
